title: Two EA-18 fighter jets collide at Mountain Home airshow, pilots ejected safely
summary: Two EA-18 Growler fighter jets collided during an airshow at Mountain Home Air Force Base in Idaho. Both pilots successfully ejected and no serious injuries were reported. The incident is under investigation.
problem_solved: This is a breaking news event, not a technical solution. It reports on an aviation accident rather than solving a problem.
why_valuable: Provides timely information about a public safety incident at a military facility, relevant to local residents and aviation enthusiasts.
